question: Can a point-in-time signal for revenue growth outpacing receivables growth provide a sufficiently covered, non-duplicate candidate for later system validation?
hypothesis: Revenue growth that materially exceeds receivables growth may reflect better collections and higher revenue quality. The factor is defined as revenue_yoy_growth minus receivables_yoy_growth; high is favorable.
selection_note: This is an economic feasibility hypothesis only. Related factors receivable_growth_yoy (R82) and working_capital_change_yoy_low (R242) have already been tested and rejected. R301 will compare signal coverage and overlap before deciding whether any later return test is justified; it will not repeat those formulas under new names.

factor.formula: revenue_growth_yoy = current cumulative YTD revenue / same fiscal period one year earlier cumulative YTD revenue - 1; receivables_growth_yoy = current accounts_receivable / accounts_receivable exactly four fiscal quarters earlier - 1; collection_quality_spread = revenue_growth_yoy - receivables_growth_yoy
factor.quarter_alignment: Exact same fiscal quarter in adjacent years; period index must differ by exactly 4. No 365-day approximation, interpolation, fill, or fallback.
factor.pit_rule: Apply backend/app/backtest/fundamentals.py financial_pit_date independently to each source table. The factor effective date is the later PIT date of the current income and balance-sheet report, plus one calendar day; require both current reports and both exact four-quarter lags. No as-of publication timestamps or historical vintages are available, so PIT is conservative statutory-date normalization, not exact original publication history.
factor.expiry_rule: Set null when signal_date minus current period_end exceeds 180 calendar days. Do not carry values across stale reports.
factor.value_rules: Require all four source values non-null and strictly positive for denominators; resulting growths and spread must be finite. No winsorization or clipping.

universe_and_period.industry_exclusion: Use the existing current industry map, excluding banks and non-bank financials; explicitly non-PIT and reported as a limitation.
universe_and_period.date_rule: A report effective on a date is not available until the next calendar day; signals are attached by backward as-of and never to a date earlier than effective_date.

feasibility_gates.F1: Full, discovery, validation and recent-252 member-row coverage each >=90%; at least one valid name on >=95% of trading dates.
feasibility_gates.F2: Maximum mean absolute monthly cross-sectional Spearman correlation versus receivable_growth_yoy_low, working_capital_change_yoy_low, asset_growth_yoy_low, ocf_margin_4q, cash_to_assets, sga_ratio_4q_low, and gross_margin_yoy_improvement_q <=0.70; calculate only month-ends with >=30 paired valid members and report all monthly counts.
feasibility_gates.F3: Monthly signal provides incremental rank information versus existing receivable_growth_yoy_low: report signal-minus-old rank residual correlation after cross-sectional linear projection, with >=30 paired names in >=80% of month-ends. This is an information/feasibility gate only, not a return test.
feasibility_gates.F4: Exact-quarter and PIT logic pass deterministic synthetic boundary checks, including duplicate source column avoidance, missing-quarter rejection, same-day exclusion, and 180-day expiry.

decision_rule: If any F gate fails, reject this direction without reading forward returns or running strategy backtests. If all pass, write a separate preregistration and then consider a first-time predictive screen/system backtest; do not change this formula, sample, or feasibility gates after observing results. A pass here never constitutes alpha.
evidence_boundary: May read financial inputs, historical membership, industry classifications, and pre-existing factor values only. Must not read forward returns, strategy return caches, or trade outcomes.
side_effect_boundary: Write only new R301 evidence and a dedicated R301 feasibility cache. Do not modify financial/market data, formal factor partitions, strategies, existing evidence, LEDGER.md, RESEARCH_SUMMARY.md, R300 files, or panel candidate store. No provider calls, builder runs, backtests, or panel writes in this feasibility stage.
known_limitations: Financial values are current snapshots with restatement risk.
financial_pit_date uses statutory deadlines where raw announce_date is late or invalid; exact historical publication timestamps are unavailable.
Current industry classification is backfilled historically and is not PIT.
R82 and R242 rejected adjacent related financial signals; any observed feasibility cannot erase these negative results.

panel_candidate_intent.name: R301 应收相对营收增速可行性审计
panel_candidate_intent.registration_policy: Do not POST this intent. Feasibility-only evidence is not a backtest candidate; any later outcome test must have its own frozen registration before outcomes are read.
